The outline of a document and the search for a name in the lib: the
inherit statements, functions, variables and macros of a file, each with
the range of the whole declaration and of its name, behind characters of
several bytes; then names found across the lib, the best match first,
with the object or the header that declares each.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
-- lib/include/std.h --
/* Grundläggande */ #define BASE "/std/base"
#define SET_MAX 10
-- lib/std/base.c --
/* blåbær */ int weight;
varargs void set_weight(int grams, string why...) {}
void create() {}
-- lib/obj/a.c --
#include <std.h>
#define TWICE(x) ((x) + (x))
inherit BASE;
inherit side "/std/side";
private int count, *list;
static void reset_all(int how);
void create() { /* først 🫐 */ ::create(); }
static void reset_all(int how) { count = TWICE(how); }
-- script --
initialize lib
open lib/obj/a.c
symbols lib/obj/a.c
# across the lib: a prefix, letters in order, another case; nothing
find set
find swt
find BASE
find nothing_of_the_kind
find
# what is being written is found as it is written
change lib/obj/a.c 7:12-7:21 "set_all"
find set_a
shutdown
exit
